visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with a black cap and white T-shirt sits at a red outdoor table at a night market, eating noodles from a cast-iron plate. Opposite him sits an elderly man in a maroon polo shirt. The lighting is warm and comes from market overheads. (2) The scene cuts to an outdoor daytime street where the elderly man wears a grey helmet and a blue medical mask, holding cash out firmly towards the camera. The young man is visible in the frame, also wearing a helmet, as they appear to be preparing to ride a scooter. (3) The two ride a scooter together down an urban street; the younger man drives while the elder man sits behind him. Both look ahead. (4) The grandfather is then shown in a rural field by a pond, casting a large white fishing net into the water. The young man is seen nearby, assisting him as they walk through dry grass. (5) In an indoor living room setting with bookshelves, the grandfather hands the younger man banknotes while he is sitting down. (6) Finally, the two are outdoors in a courtyard during the day; they approach each other and share a long, sincere hug while wearing casual caps.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 爺爺 我問你為什麼小時候... [Logo]: 影片完整版 / YI:Andy老師. (2) [Subtitle]: 對我都不嚴格? (3) [Variety]: 我疼啊. (4) [Subtitle]: 對啊 疼孫子啊. (5) [Subtitle]: 不用啦 我自己付啦. (6) [Subtitle]: 爺爺很堅持要付. (7) [Subtitle]: 一樣的啦. (8) [Subtitle]: 以前我會叛逆、不聽話. (9) [Subtitle]: 我都很早出門 沒有補習. (10) [Subtitle]: 然后偷跑去打電動. (11) [Subtitle]: 爺爺依然無微不至的照顧我. (12) [Subtitle]: 而且那時候 生很重很重的病嘛. (13) [Subtitle]: 對對對. (14) [Subtitle]: 為了減少家庭開支去捕魚. (15) [Subtitle]: 怎麼了? (16) [Subtitle]: 拿 去吃牛排. (17) [Subtitle]: 爺爺說: 沒關係, 這些都過去了. (18) [Subtitle]: 我現在要回台北了. (19) [Subtitle]: 祝你一路順風. (20) [Subtitle]: 順風 抱抱. (21) [Subtitle]: 好好好.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 young male creator, 1 elderly male grandfather.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The young man wears a black baseball cap and a white T-shirt with black trim. The grandfather wears a maroon or purple polo shirt and occasionally a black cap or helmet.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Outdoor night market with red tables and cooking equipment; urban street with buildings and scooters; rural pond with dry grass; indoor room with wooden bookshelves and a ceiling fan.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A young man's voice initiates a conversation with a warm, conversational pitch over a sentimental, mid-tempo acoustic guitar and piano BGM. The environment has a faint outdoor hum. (2) An older man's voice, exhibiting natural raspiness but clear affection, replies with a calm tone. The BGM remains steady in the background. (3) The young man begins a narrative voice-over. A low engine hum and wind rustle are audible during a sequence on a scooter. A sharp 'splash' sound occurs as a fishing net hits the water, momentarily punctuating the BGM. (4) The tone becomes more emotional as the young man narrates his memories of past illness and his grandfather's care. Paper-like rustling is heard as cash is handed over. (5) The dialogue reaches a peak during a farewell outdoor scene. The elder man's voice is soft and reassuring. The audio ends with the faint sound of clothing rustling during a hug, followed by a gentle piano fade.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Retrospective -> Emotional Peak -> Farewell
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To express deep gratitude and love for a grandfather who provided selfless care and support during the narrator's rebellious youth and illness.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly emotional, family-oriented piece utilizing a mix of present-day dialogue and retrospective montage to build a narrative of generational bond.
